environment: Isaac Sim 5.1 / IsaacLab 2.3, EgoVLA Ego-Humanoid benchmark
instruction: Put can on the saucer, and Close the drawer
success_definition: env success: can upright on the saucer (< 9 cm, < 2 cm) AND door >= 80 % closed
reset: env.reset() with cfg.randomize_idx = start id (room 1, table 2), then 60 settle steps holding the default pose; no demonstration-derived warm-up
teacher_observation: main 960x540, left eye, both wrist cameras, previous main image; wrist poses / directions, fingertips, thumb-index distance, closure fractions, index contact force, arm joints, calibration hints, budgets, history
student_observation: fixed main camera (1280x720) resized to 224x224 INTER_AREA, RGB /255 + ImageNet norm; proprio zeroed (STATELESS)
teacher_action: wrist targets (position + finger/palm directions) interpolated <= 1 cm / 3 deg per step + 4 hand-closure fractions; executed through the same native 38-D step as the student (IK holds for held arms)
student_action: 38-D [L wrist xyz+quat wxyz, R wrist xyz+quat wxyz, L hand 12, R hand 12] absolute, world frame; IK (L DLS, R pinv) every step
normalization: per-dimension mean/std over the training set's timesteps (std >= 0.01), ACT convention; continuations keep the anchor's stats
label_rule: action_t = the 38-D command dispatched at step t after observing o_t; chunk = actions t..t+24 inside the same teacher segment, zero-padded with is_pad beyond it (ACT convention); quaternion signs made continuous

student_init.kind: ACT from scratch (ImageNet ResNet-18 backbone as in the project's ACT)

recipe.optimizer: AdamW (policy.configure_optimizers: lr 1e-5, backbone lr 1e-5, weight decay 1e-4), no LR schedule, no clipping
recipe.note: the project's recipe is 2000 epochs of one sampled timestep per episode; the study fixes the UPDATE count instead (same for D1 / D3 / DN / failures), as the spec requires equal update budgets across data sizes
